The AIUI health API provides endpoints to monitor server and provider health status.

The following status values are used throughout the health API: Status Meaning Color Code "ok" Service is functioning normally Green "healthy" Service is functioning normally (legacy) Green "degraded" Service is partially functional Yellow "error" Service has errors Red "unknown" Status cannot be determined Yellow Note: Both "ok" and "healthy" indicate successful operation. The system accepts either value for backward compatibility.

Returns detailed JSON health information from the provider gateway. Always responds with Content-Type: application/json. The base fields from the provider's health() payload are merged with the normalised fields below. Response: Field Type Description status string One of the health status values above. type string Provider type (from provider field, falls back to class name). agents integer Count of agents reported by the provider. detail string Human-readable detail; "ok" for healthy providers. api_key string Built-in PraisonAIProvider only: "set" when a model key is in the environment (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, …), a local base URL is set (OLLAMA_HOST, OPENAI_BASE_URL, …) or a key is saved in Settings; "missing" otherwise. Absent for other providers (unknown). The app shell shows "Add an API key to start" above the composer when it is "missing". Note: Any unmatched /api/* path returns a JSON 404 (never the SPA HTML shell), so API clients can rely on parsing the response body.
Check server health status: The command displays: Green panel for "ok" or "healthy" status Yellow panel for other statuses Red error message if server is unreachable
